steps.en: Install the skill, then run the one-time setup that installs the scanners it drives
steps.zh: 装上这个 skill，再跑一次性安装脚本装好它调用的扫描器
steps.code: npx skills add elliottwaves-20/agent-guard · bash setup.sh

steps.en: Hand it the link of the skill, MCP package or archive you are about to install
steps.zh: 把准备安装的 skill、MCP 包或压缩包链接交给它

steps.en: Fetches one exact commit as a ZIP snapshot; nothing is cloned or executed
steps.zh: 按确定的 commit 下载 ZIP 快照，不克隆也不执行任何东西

steps.en: Routes the target to the matching scanner and runs its LLM pass in a separate tool-less process
steps.zh: 按目标类型分派给对应扫描器，LLM 评审放在无工具的独立进程里

steps.en: Merges every stage into one verdict: exit 0 SAFE, 1 BLOCK, 2 no verdict
steps.zh: 把各阶段合并成一个结论：退出码 0 安全、1 拦截、2 无结论

steps.en: After a SAFE verdict, install that same scanned copy
steps.zh: 拿到 SAFE 之后，安装刚才扫过的同一份内容

steps.en: Re-scans a staging copy, then links it into every agent it detects on the machine
steps.zh: 对暂存副本再扫一遍，然后链接进本机检测到的每个 agent

value.en: One scan and one verdict cover all your agents, and what got installed is exactly what was scanned
value.zh: 扫一次、判一次就覆盖你所有的 agent，装进去的正是扫过的那一份

README 'The right professional scanner for each target' and 'LLM provider support' (separate tool-less LLM process)
